content: Hi! How can I help you today?
I need an SQL query to list all user logins from last week.

```sql
SELECT user_id, login_timestamp
FROM access_logs
WHERE login_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND login_timestamp < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE);
```
Add the IP address to the result.

```sql
SELECT user_id, login_timestamp, ip_address
FROM access_logs
WHERE login_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND login_timestamp < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE);
```
Can you filter for users in the 'finance' department only?

```sql
SELECT al.user_id, al.login_timestamp, al.ip_address
FROM access_logs al
JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.department = 'finance'
  AND al.login_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND al.login_timestamp < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE);
```
I also want to see the user's full name.

```sql
SELECT al.user_id, u.full_name, al.login_timestamp, al.ip_address
FROM access_logs al
JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.department = 'finance'
  AND al.login_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND al.login_timestamp < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE);
```
What about showing only successful logins?

```sql
SELECT al.user_id, u.full_name, al.login_timestamp, al.ip_address
FROM access_logs al
JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.department = 'finance'
  AND al.status = 'success'
  AND al.login_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND al.login_timestamp < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE);
```
Can you sort the results by most recent login?

```sql
SELECT al.user_id, u.full_name, al.login_timestamp, al.ip_address
FROM access_logs al
JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.department = 'finance'
  AND al.status = 'success'
  AND al.login_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND al.login_timestamp < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)
ORDER BY al.login_timestamp DESC;
```
How can I get the count of unique users who logged in successfully from that department?

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT al.user_id) AS unique_user_count
FROM access_logs al
JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.department = 'finance'
  AND al.status = 'success'
  AND al.login_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND al.login_timestamp < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE);
```
Now show me the first and last login times per user.

```sql
SELECT al.user_id, u.full_name,
       MIN(al.login_timestamp) AS first_login,
       MAX(al.login_timestamp) AS last_login
FROM access_logs al
JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.department = 'finance'
  AND al.status = 'success'
  AND al.login_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND al.login_timestamp < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY al.user_id, u.full_name;
```
